subject: legend at specific position outside the graphic area

messages.author: f7a628c0cc281126
messages.subject: legend at specific position outside the graphic area
parts:
Does anybody know how to place the legend at, for example, bottom left corner outside the graphic area? Is it, actually, possible?

I only know how to put it at the bottom, but it always appears centered (theme's legend.position="bottom"). I mean, it does'nt exist the "bottomleft" value or something similar. Other values of position (i.e. legend.position=c=(1,0)) shows the legend inside the graphic area, and this is not what I want. Any idea?

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: legend at specific position outside the graphic area
parts:
It looks like legend.position accepts negative values, so combining
that with plot.margin should get you the desired effect, I think, e.g.

> last_plot() + theme(legend.position = c(-0.05, -0.05), plot.margin=unit(c(0.5,0.5,1.5,0.5),"cm"))

Ben
